cases.prompt: Create a Surface specification for an accessible browser service that lets a resident report a street problem, review their answers, and receive a confirmation reference. Use HTML, TypeScript, Deno, and GOV.UK Frontend 6.4.0. Require official design-system components with no custom CSS. Ask for a problem type, location, optional details, and email, with ordered field errors.
acceptance: The result is valid frozen Surface 0.1 KDL with exactly one application and at least one screen.
The application's web stack targets browser and declares markup html, language typescript, runtime deno, and designSystem govUkFrontend with quoted version 6.4.0.
Design-system implementation guidance is attached with context; no design or component declaration is invented.
A global enum value defines the allowed problem types and a street-report collection uses a checked enum value reference.
Validation and submission are functions with checked collection input and output references.
Exact validation order, review behavior, and confirmation behavior remain in logic instruction strings.
Interface context describes accessibility and official component usage without structured UI children.
The screen uses the interface and describes / through logic.
The frozen Surface 0.1 grammar is not extended to satisfy the request.

cases.prompt: Starting from examples/online-checkout/surface.kdl, change the pinned design system to NHS.UK Frontend 10.2.0 and require official NHS components without custom CSS. Preserve the application behavior, data contracts, copy, screen, and unrelated content.
acceptance: Only the existing designSystem technology name, quoted version, and directly related context are changed.
The design system remains a technology in the application web stack and is not moved into a new declaration.
No structured component, button, form, design, or theme node is introduced.
All collections, values, functions, interface logic, screen logic, and unrelated content are preserved.
The result remains valid frozen Surface 0.1 KDL.

cases.prompt: Diagnose a Surface file that puts designSystem "govUkFrontend" at the top level, uses technology "designSystem" "govUkFrontend" version=6.4 in its web stack, and adds button and textInput children to an interface.
acceptance: The response identifies the top-level designSystem declaration, numeric technology version, and structured interface children as invalid Surface 0.1.
It keeps the design system as technology "designSystem" "govUkFrontend" version="6.4" inside the application stack.
It moves component and customization guidance into interface or technology context rather than inventing UI nodes.
It distinguishes valid KDL from valid Surface.
It treats Surface 0.1 as frozen and every correction uses only released syntax.
